facts.fact: The article says the Cobac regulation of 21 December 2018 replaced the 2011 e-money framework and created the payment institution status for CEMAC states including Chad.

Moov Money Tchad SA obtained payment institution approval in the first half of 2026, joining Airtel Money (March 2022) and Konoom (October 2025), per Maroc Telecom's half-year report cited by Ecomatin.
